Name: Jeroham, Father of Adaiah
Summary: Father of Adaiah the priest, son of Pashur son of Malchijah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Adaiah the priest, son of Pashur son of Malchijah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeroham in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
